**What are you proposing?**
A clear description of the feature.

**Which paper or spec section does this relate to, if any?**
E.g. "P4 §5.4, D4 taint gating" or "a new tool in `tokenis/spec/tool-surface.md`".

**Does this require weakening or changing a well-formedness condition
(W1-W6)?**
If yes, explain which one and why it's still sound — see
`tokenis/spec/well-formedness.md`.

**Are you willing to open a PR for this?**
Larger changes should be discussed here first — see
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#scope-of-changes-were-likely-to-accept).
